name: School Festival ~Cosmos Sai Kitan~
original_name: スクールフェスティバル ～秋桜祭奇譚～
source:
Hero is a high school teacher and also consultant of ethics committee. The day before the cultural festival, it was cancelled by the principal due to diminished public morals. It's our job to investigate the truth behind the cancellation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-january-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名高中教师，同时担任风纪委员会顾问。文化祭前一天，校长以校内风气败坏为由突然取消活动。我们的任务，就是查明活动取消背后的真相。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-january-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
